response.body:
The current project indexes still described merged PRs as an open stack and omitted later scoped transport evidence. This reconciles state, roadmap and experimental summary against GitHub main `989e703` and current evidence, preserves the complete formerly dirty state/roadmap as snapshots, and turns the missing pinned Amethyst control into an explicit runbook and read-only readiness command.

The reviewed preflight actually ran on the host: exit2/PREPARATION_BLOCKED only for persistent disk space (175,497,216 bytes available; retained6GiB guard). Cached pinned APK/manifest, SDK metadata/presence, memory, KVM and local Docker checks passed. No emulator, E01–E06 experiment, crypto or network laboratory was launched. Raw JSON, execution facts and independent reviews are included.

Validation and evidence:

- All116 canonical source/configuration/lock references match current bytes; canonical results remain PASS140 / PARTIAL22 / PASS19 / NOT EXECUTED / PASS25 / NOT EXECUTED.
- Separately accepted E04 limitedPARTIAL and E06 component/compositionPARTIAL are identified with their limits; neither is promoted to fullPASS.
- Independent QA/security source review accepted the read-only preflight; final bounded-package reviews are included.
-35 frozen package files and73 active Markdown links were checked against the package plus trackedmain; initial dirty state/roadmap hashes are preserved exactly; Git whitespace checks pass.

Remaining work is explicit: actual Amethyst rendering/inner-content/tag control, its export driver/evidence integration, E04 broader frame/relay/resource matrix, E06 received-D/F metadata authority and negative cases, and the known target-policy marker fix. The12/16-byte attachment brief distinguishes source, crypto and actual producer interoperability; batch-reuse suspicion remains conditional SOURCE evidence. Q01/Q08/Q13/Q15/Q27 remain BLOCKER.

Scope: bounded readiness/preparation package only. The55k preexisting untracked files/full local runtime graphs are not silently bundled or represented as a portable replay archive. No canonical gate/status rewrite, nonce truncation, profile adoption, SDK, production change, new kind/NIP or automatic merge. Existing PO decisions are not reopened. Minimal external action is disk headroom, not new KVM permissions or another APK build.
